title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 5 — WORLD 8: B2 ADVANCED COMMUNICATION & REAL-WORLD MASTERY
description: A demanding B2 world that develops flexible, natural and independent English through nuance, advanced grammar, extended texts, authentic-speed listening, discussion, professional communication and complex real-life tasks.

targets.active_vocabulary: 1800+ words, collocations, phrasal verbs, idiomatic expressions and academic-functional language
targets.reading: 1400–1600 words with inference, writer purpose, tone, structure, reference and evidence
targets.listening: 12–14 minutes of natural-speed multi-speaker English with interruptions, reduced forms and implied meaning
targets.conversation: 16–18 minutes of sustained discussion, negotiation and spontaneous interaction
targets.writing: 350–420 words with strong cohesion, varied syntax, examples, counterarguments and controlled register
targets.presentation: 7 minutes plus audience questions and follow-up discussion
targets.real_life: professional communication, education, travel, services, digital communication, complaints, negotiation and public situations

missions.title: B2 Lexical Precision — Collocations, Phrasal Verbs & Idioms
missions.content: Build a large active lexical network, distinguish near-synonyms, choose natural collocations and use common idiomatic and phrasal language accurately rather than translating word by word.

missions.title: Grammar Mastery — Aspect, Sequence & Meaning
missions.content: Control complex time relationships and select grammar according to meaning, emphasis, duration, completion, expectation and current relevance.

missions.title: Modal Logic — Deduction, Criticism & Probability
missions.content: Evaluate evidence and express certainty, probability, criticism and expectation about present and past situations with precise modal structures.

missions.title: Conditional Thinking — Mixed Time & Complex Consequences
missions.content: Explore alternative realities, regrets and present consequences of past choices while producing flexible conditional sentences in extended communication.

missions.title: Advanced Clause Lab — Compress & Expand Ideas
missions.content: Combine multiple ideas into efficient B2 sentences, unpack dense sentences and reformulate complex information clearly.

missions.title: Reporting & Passive English — Professional Information Flow
missions.content: Transform information for reports, news, workplace communication and formal explanations using accurate passive and reporting structures.

missions.title: Cohesion & Coherence — Build a Powerful Paragraph
missions.content: Create and repair paragraphs so every sentence contributes to a clear progression of ideas, with accurate reference and logical connections.

missions.title: Nuance Mission — Hedging, Emphasis & Diplomatic English
missions.content: Adjust strength and tone to sound appropriately confident, cautious, polite, critical or diplomatic in social and professional situations.

missions.title: Critical Reading — Claims, Evidence & Perspective
missions.content: Analyze an extended article, separate claims from evidence, identify perspective and infer meaning that is not directly stated.

missions.title: B2 Conversation Lab — Eighteen-Minute Real Discussion
missions.content: Sustain a complex conversation about technology, education, work, travel and society while handling interruptions, follow-up questions and unexpected changes of topic.

missions.title: Reading Mastery — The Future of Everyday Life
missions.content: Read a long analytical text and identify the author's central argument, supporting evidence, shifts in perspective, implied conclusions and contextual vocabulary.

missions.title: Listening Mastery — Four Voices, One Problem
missions.content: Follow a 12–14 minute multi-speaker discussion in which people disagree, clarify, interrupt and negotiate; reconstruct the main issue and each speaker's position.

missions.title: Writing Mastery — The Balanced B2 Essay
missions.content: Produce a polished balanced essay with a clear thesis, developed paragraphs, examples, counterargument, accurate linking and an effective conclusion.

missions.title: Presentation Mission — Explain a Complex Issue
missions.content: Present a complex issue clearly, compare alternatives, explain evidence, use transitions naturally and answer follow-up questions without memorized scripts.

missions.title: Real-Life English — Travel Disruption Command Center
missions.content: Manage a realistic travel disruption involving transport, accommodation and schedule changes; explain the situation, negotiate alternatives and confirm the final plan.

missions.title: Real-Life English — Professional Meeting & Email Mission
missions.content: Read a workplace request, participate in a meeting, clarify responsibilities, negotiate a deadline and write a concise professional follow-up message.

missions.title: Debate Arena — Evidence, Rebuttal & Persuasion
missions.content: Develop a position on a challenging topic, test another argument, respond to objections and strengthen your own case through evidence and precise language.

missions.title: Real-World Simulation — One Week, Ten Decisions
missions.content: Navigate a simulated week involving work, study, travel, money, appointments and communication problems. Make decisions, justify them and adapt when circumstances change.

missions.title: B2 Mastery Marathon — Accuracy Meets Fluency
missions.content: Complete a high-demand integrated assessment combining vocabulary in context, grammar editing, extended reading, natural listening, spontaneous discussion, pronunciation repair and structured writing.

missions.title: WORLD 8 MASTER QUEST — B2 ADVANCED COMMUNICATION
missions.content: Final mission integrating advanced lexical control, complex grammar, inference reading, natural listening, sustained conversation, professional communication, debate, presentation and a multi-stage real-world simulation.

quality_rules.progression: World 8 recycles World 6–7 language while increasing length, speed, nuance and independence.
quality_rules.protected_note: This curriculum file adds Grade 5 World 8 only and does not modify Grade 2, Grade 3 or Grade 4.
